cr_data.provenance: (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Private collection, Palm Beach, Florida, 1968; (Steven Straw Company, Newburyport, Massachusetts, and private dealer, Fort Pierce, Florida); Benwood Foundation, Chattanooga, Tennessee, before 1976; Hunter Museum of Art, Chattanooga, Tennessee, gift, 1976; (Private dealer, Fort Pierce, Florida); (Wolfgang Pogzeba, Denver, Colorado); Private collection, Denver, Colorado, 1977; (Allan Stone Gallery, New York, NY); (Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946 [notes inscription 1]. . . . Initials. Black tree trunk, Yellow autumn leaves, blue background. . . . Ptd. 1929." Backing inscription dates 1928 and 1929. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1929. Dated 1929 on basis of inclusion in 1930 New York (An American Place) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 32. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Black Maple Trunk – Yellow Leaves

description: A black maple tree full of yellow leaves spans the length of the composition. The green leaves of another tree are visible behind the maple, along with a pale blue background with a stripe of white at the bottom of the composition.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
